CA.rationale: A content position (red at candidate node) is explicitly paired with a processing origin ('command_estimate') for the same candidate/time.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates (red/blue) are given and their presentation/organization is shown, while a separate origin/status metadata entry distinguishes source/status for the same node/time.

A.rationale: A processing/estimation origin ('command_estimate') is explicitly linked to the candidate content coordinates for the same candidate/time.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify items by color with literal coordinate attributes in the current record structure.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata entries separately attribute source/estimation status to identified content nodes, distinguishing identity from status.

O.rationale: The report states how content is organized/presented (coordinate groupings and display orientation) for current and candidate records.
